rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I knew he was no ordinary man, but I
never imagined Leon's willpower was
this strong.

rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0002
rows.name:
When Heaven's Holy Grail attacked, I
thought I was going to die here. Leon
didn't.

rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0003
rows.name:
He said it was times like these when
music is most important and that we
couldn't just stand idly by.

rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Everything after that was a blur.
We helped guide the people
who were fleeing.

rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0005
rows.name:
We're still trying to help, in our
own way - performing for scared,
crying kids and worried people.

rows.label: tlk70000035_03_msg0006
rows.name:
It probably doesn't reach most people,
but Leon's courage reached me loud and
clear. How could I do nothing?
